title: kpiMetric
description: Canonical shared definition for KPI metrics across the system. Each metric carries its value AND its provenance (source enum, optional source_name, as_of date, optional verified_at timestamp). Referenced via $ref by `brand_deal.schema.json` ($defs.kpiMetric) and `performance_report_pack.schema.json` ($defs.kpiMetric), and indirectly by `deal.schema.json` (via deal.close.final_kpis which carries the report's kpis verbatim). On agent send of a performance report, kpis values write into `deal.close.final_kpis` and ultimately into `brand_deal.kpis` on auto-archive — the SAME shape carries through that loop.

value.description: The metric value. For rates (engagement_rate_pct, ctr_pct), this is a percentage 0-100.

source.description: platform_verified = pulled directly from IG / TikTok / YouTube Insights API; brand_reported = brand provided the figure; third_party = Tribe Dynamics / HypeAuditor / similar; calculated = derived from other fields (e.g. CPM from fee/impressions); self_reported = talent's claim (lowest confidence); estimated = back-calculated when no source. Email generator + report renderer strongly prefer platform_verified > brand_reported > third_party when citing metrics.

source_name.description: Specific source identifier (e.g. 'Instagram Insights API', 'Tribe Dynamics Q4 2025 report').

as_of.description: When this figure was captured. KPIs continue to grow after campaign end (e.g. viral pickup); the as_of date tells us when the snapshot was taken.
